archetype: Melee STR warrior rebuilt around a two-stance kit. Shinsoku skills are the fast, low-commitment half of the kit; Battou skills are the slow, heavy half. Using a Battou skill puts the character into the Akatsuki state, which grants final damage and ignore-defense for its duration, so the intended loop alternates between the two stances to hold Akatsuki up rather than committing to one stance. The 5th job buff Shogetsu Form layers on top of that state with higher multipliers, knockback immunity and amplified Battou damage. IMPORTANT: this describes the REWORKED Hayato introduced in GMS v266 (The Sengoku Warrior Reawakening). The pre-v266 kit (Rai Sanrenzan, Hitokiri Strike, Jin Battoujutsu) no longer exists and most guides still on the open web describe it.

hexa.notes: NO SOURCE FOR HEXA INVESTMENT ORDER. This is the single biggest gap for this class and it is a real hole in the public record, not a research shortfall. Specifically: (1) the Hayato class doc 'The Way of the Blade' DOES contain a 6th job section, but that doc is stranded at v252 and describes the pre-revamp kit - it names the Origin skill as 'Jin Battoujutsu: Owari No Susanoo' and Mastery cores as 'Rai Sanrenzan VI' and 'Rai Blade Flash VI', none of which are skills the reworked class has. Its HEXA order is therefore not merely stale, it is describing a different character. Do not use it. (2) Grandis Library's Hayato page has no HEXA Matrix section at all, consistent with Grandis having no HEXA layer for any class. It does list three Class Infographics tabs labelled Overview, 6th Job (Heroic) and 6th Job (Interactive) - the Heroic one is very likely the artifact a player needs, but it is an image and its contents could not be read here. (3) MapleDoro's Hayato HEXA guide is explicitly marked Work In Progress and redirects readers to the class doc or Discord. (4) DigitalTQ lists the 6th job skills but states no investment order. The only plausible live source is the Hayato Discord (https://discord.gg/EAkfmrx), which requires a human to read pins. HEXA skill NAMES are sourced and safe to display; the ORDER is not available. Because this character is Lv 236, this gap is not yet blocking - 6th job unlocks at Lv 260.

hyperStats.notes: NO POST-REVAMP SOURCE. The only hyper stat guidance found anywhere for Hayato is in the v252 class doc, which lists Critical Damage, Ignore Enemy Defense and Boss Damage as the bossing focus. That doc predates the v266 rework, and the rework changed the class's passive crit and IED baselines, which is exactly what determines where hyper stat points stop paying off - so the pre-revamp ordering cannot be carried across and is recorded here only as a flagged historical claim, not a recommendation. Separately, and independent of Hayato: the community's operative answer to hyper stat priority is a per-character computation rather than a fixed list, via MathBro's Hyper Stat Optimizer (https://brendonmay.github.io/hyperCalculator/). A static priority list is a simplification that better-informed players reject, so for this class the honest output is to point at the calculator.

innerAbility.notes: Inner ability is the best-preserved field across the rework, because IA lines are generic stat lines rather than skill-specific, so the pre-revamp doc's recommendations remain broadly meaningful where they agree with the current page. Attack speed does NOT appear in either source's recommended lines, which is consistent with the class reaching high attack speed from its own passives (see gearingNotes). No source was found that recommends a cooldown-skip line for this class despite Reactive Focus being cooldown-relevant.

gearingNotes:
CLASS-SPECIFIC HOOKS, all from the current post-revamp source unless noted.

1. The link skill is CONDITIONAL and the condition is a gearing target. Moonlit Blade Learnings only pays out at 100%+ Critical Rate and 50% Critical Damage. Both the link skill and the Legion effect give Critical Damage, so the class's own contributions push one side of a threshold that requires the other side to be satisfied first from gear and hyper stats.

2. The class supplies a large amount of crit from passives - roughly +45% Critical Rate and +30% Critical Damage base from its own skills (rising into the 65-67% range on Critical Damage with buffs). That materially changes where crit investment stops paying off compared to a class with no passive crit, and it is the reason a flat cross-class hyper stat or inner ability recommendation is a poor fit here.

3. Ignore DEF is around +48% from passives, reaching roughly +72.7% with buffs active. IED stacks multiplicatively, so a high passive baseline lowers the marginal value of further IED from gear and hyper stats.

4. Attack speed reaches 8 from passives, with a 1.25x weapon multiplier and 99% weapon mastery. Because the class is already fast natively, the +1 attack speed inner ability line is not among either source's recommended lines.

5. Akatsuki uptime is the mechanical constraint that gear should serve. Because Akatsuki is entered by using a Battou skill and grants final damage plus ignore-defense for its duration, buff duration has more value here than it would for a class with no maintained state - which is consistent with Buff Duration +38% appearing as a recommended inner ability line.

STALE, FROM THE v252 DOC AND FLAGGED AS SUCH - recorded only so they are not mistaken for current advice: a 10 attack speed target via Booster / Quick Draw / green potions / Decent Speed Infusion, a 95-97% visual IED target, Princess No's Kodachi as the secondary, Attack-line WSE with 9 attack preferred, and a cooldown hat as optional quality-of-life. The secondary weapon choice and WSE advice are the most likely of these to have survived the rework, but none of it was confirmed against a post-v266 source.
commonMistakes: Using any Hayato guide that names Rai Sanrenzan, Rai Blade Flash, Hitokiri Strike or Jin Battoujutsu: Owari No Susanoo. Those skills belong to the pre-v266 class and no longer exist. This is the dominant failure mode for Hayato specifically, because the class doc linked from both the community wiki index and from Grandis Library is one of those guides.

Treating the linked class doc 'The Way of the Blade' as current. It is the top result a player will find, it is the doc the ecosystem points at, and it is stranded at v252 - before the v266 Sengoku Warrior Reawakening. Its 6th job section in particular describes an Origin skill the class does not have.

Counting Grandis Library and the Hayato class doc as two agreeing sources. Grandis credits the Hayato Discord for its inner ability, hyper passive and boost node fields, and the doc comes from that same Discord. They are one consensus family.
Rolling attack speed on inner ability. The class already reaches attack speed 8 from passives and no source recommends the line.

Assuming the link skill is working. Moonlit Blade Learnings does nothing until the character is at 100%+ Critical Rate and 50% Critical Damage, so on a fresh or low-progression character it can be contributing zero while appearing active.

Trusting a node-trio table's date stamp. The one consolidated cross-class trio reference used here displays 'Last update: November 21st, 2024' while simultaneously listing post-v266 skill names for both Hayato and Kanna - its own date line is demonstrably wrong, in the direction of understating currency.

conflicts.topic: Boost node trio composition - which Moon Cut belongs in the main trio
conflicts.positionA: Trio #1 is [Shinsoku] Mist Slash + [Shinsoku] Crescent Moon Cut + [Shinsoku] Afterimage Slash, with [Battou] Full Moon's Rage and [Shinsoku] Silent Arc forming a second trio.
conflicts.positionB: The first trinode is [Shinsoku] Mist Slash + [Battou] Full Moon's Rage + either [Shinsoku] Crescent Moon Cut or [Battou] Dark Moon Cut, and the second is [Shinsoku] Silent Arc + [Shinsoku] Afterimage Slash + either [Shinsoku] Grazing Cut or [Shinsoku] Stormcloud Splitter.
conflicts.status: contested - recorded, not resolved. The two sources place Full Moon's Rage and Afterimage Slash in different trios and disagree on whether Crescent Moon Cut or Dark Moon Cut is the intended partner. Neither source is strong enough to override the other: one has an unreliable date stamp, the other is a content farm. Resolve via the Hayato Discord.

conflicts.topic: Which skills are boostable at all
conflicts.positionA: The boost node table lists six nodes covering Mist Slash, Grazing Cut + Reactive Focus, Dark Moon Cut, Afterimage Slash, Full Moon's Rage, and Silent Arc. Crescent Moon Cut and Stormcloud Splitter do not appear.
conflicts.positionB: Crescent Moon Cut and Stormcloud Splitter are named as trio members, implying they are boostable.
conflicts.status: contested - most likely an extraction truncation on the first source rather than a real disagreement, since that page carries a 'View Pre-V.269 Boost Nodes' toggle indicating collapsible content. Flagged so the six-node list is not treated as exhaustive.

conflicts.topic: Boost node tier ordering (PRIMARY / SECONDARY / OTHER)
conflicts.positionA: Three separate reads of the same source page returned three different tier assignments; the skill contents of each node were identical across all three reads but the labels were not.
conflicts.positionB: No second source publishes a Hayato boost node tier ordering at all.

researchNotes: Hayato is structurally harder to source than most classes for a reason worth recording: it is a Japan-originated class, so the KMS cross-check lane that the project brief relies on for other classes (NamuWiki, Orange Mushroom) does not usefully exist. A search of Orange Mushroom returned no Hayato posts, and the NamuWiki Hayato pages returned HTTP 403 to fetching on both URL forms tried. maplestorywiki.net/w/Hayato/Skills - the intended anti-fabrication name-validation table - returned 403 to fetching and the browser was denied navigation to that host, and the Fandom mirror returned HTTP 402. Skill names in this file were therefore validated by triangulation across three separately authored sources instead of against a neutral wiki table; every skill name recorded here appears in at least two of those, except where explicitly marked single-source. The web search budget for this session was exhausted (200/200) before this class was researched, so all findings come from direct fetches of URLs already known from the project's discovery phase. Nexon's official v266 patch notes are JS-rendered and returned an empty shell; reading them in a browser would be the cleanest way to validate the post-revamp skill list independently and is the recommended next step, alongside a human pass on the Hayato Discord for HEXA order.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
defects: FALSE SOURCE CLAIM, and it inverts the source's actual recommendation. vMatrix.trios[4] says the pre-revamp class doc 'also put Princess Sakuno's Blessing in its high-priority list'. I read the doc (docs.google.com/document/d/1P4mBaIAc-YgycrtemcaUmuo13YRkbA0FP-MbJb1fzIo/mobilebasic). It has two lists. High Priority: Shinsoku, Sanrenzan/Blade Flash, Hitokiri Hundred Strike, Falcon's Honor. LOW Priority: Iaijutsu Phantom Blade, Sengoku Force Assemble, Princess Sakuno's Blessing, Decent Holy Symbol, Weapon Aura. Princess Sakuno's Blessing is in the LOW list. The file used a deprioritization as corroboration to raise a recommendation from weak to moderate.
FALSE SOURCE CLAIM. The same entry says the class doc 'independently echoed' the Twilight Bloom + Princess Sakuno's Blessing pair. 'Twilight Bloom' does not appear anywhere in that document.

MISATTRIBUTED CORROBORATION. innerAbility.bossing[2] says 'the pre-revamp doc separately listed Weapon Attack 15-21 and Buff Duration 38% as its non-top lines, matching the pairing'. In the doc, Buff Duration 38% is in the FARMING/training list (18-20% Meso Obtained, 38% Buff Duration, 7-8% Normal Monster Damage). Its bossing list is Boss Damage / Weapon Attack / Abnormal Status Damage - no Buff Duration. The claimed pairing match does not exist, and this same misreading is what gearingNotes item 5 then builds its Akatsuki/buff-duration theory on.

UNVERIFIED DETAIL attributed to a source. innerAbility.training[0] says the class doc 'gave 18-20% Meso Obtained and 18-20% Item Drop'. The doc's farming list I retrieved contains Meso Obtained only; no Item Drop line was present. Lower confidence than the three above (fetch summarisation could be lossy), but it should be re-checked before it ships.

MISCHARACTERISED CLASS FACT (sourced, but conflicting and the conflict is unrecorded). vMatrix.trios[4] labels Twilight Bloom and Princess Sakuno's Blessing 'Cross-class Sengoku nodes ... recommended for all Sengoku classes, not Hayato-specific'. That framing is DigitalTQ's ('All Sengoku classes should try to also obtain these'), so it is not invented - but Grandis Library lists BOTH as Hayato's own 5th Job skills, alongside Shogetsu Form, Weapon Aura, Impenetrable Skin and [Battou] Wailing Heavens. The two sources disagree on what these things even are, and that disagreement is nowhere in the conflicts array.
clearedOnInspection: NO fabricated skill or node names found. Every name in the file checks out against at least one source I re-read independently: all six boost-node skills, Crescent Moon Cut and Stormcloud Splitter (Grandis 3rd job), Silent Arc (Grandis Hyper Skill), Shogetsu Form / Princess Sakuno's Blessing / Twilight Bloom / Weapon Aura / Impenetrable Skin / [Battou] Wailing Heavens (Grandis 5th job), Shin Quick Draw and Fleeting Breath (Grandis 6th job AND DigitalTQ), the six HEXA Mastery names, Sol Janus, Bushido, Akatsuki Blessing, and 'Moonlit Blade Learnings' (Grandis and MapleDoro). The two weakest names are '[Shinsoku] Crashing Tide' (DigitalTQ only; absent from Grandis entirely) and '[Shinsoku] Light Cutter' (DigitalTQ, plus one unlabelled appearance in Grandis's preview strip). Neither is fabricated, but the file's 'weak - single source' tag on enhancementCores is doing more work than its prose admits.
